question: Should the new already-running repair-drift warning be accepted as the gateway-start output contract after direct terminal proof confirms it does not restart or repair the service?
rationale: The warning intentionally changes CLI and JSON-visible behavior, while the PR currently supplies only test and static-validation claims; the protected maintainer label requires an explicit owner decision.

options.title: Approve after live proof
options.body: Accept the cleanup once a redacted terminal or live JSON run shows the warning and confirms the running service was not restarted or repaired.

options.title: Keep output silent
options.body: Remove the warning if maintainers decide that a no-op `gateway start` must preserve its previous output contract.

recommendation.title: Approve after live proof
recommendation.body: Accept the cleanup once a redacted terminal or live JSON run shows the warning and confirms the running service was not restarted or repaired.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged lifecycle work and this follow-up branch place the gateway-start contract decision closest to this contributor's area history.
